metadata.teardown: kill the private Linux process group, reap the leader and await live descendants before deleting its private home; D-state members are waited out
metadata.protocol: installed CLI metadata only; no install/pull/login/script execution

archives.redirectPolicy: deny; credentials never follow a redirect

credentials.ownership: explicit owner and tenant; no ambient or personal legacy fallback
credentials.delivery: private stdin descriptor to trusted node bootstrap; no secret in OS argv or inherited environment
credentials.childEnvironment: allowlist; private HOME/TMPDIR and empty dedicated SSO cache; no CIBA or interactive login

snapshots.authority: complete validated content-sealed bytes; metadata or timestamps alone never prove unchanged content
snapshots.firstCheck: baseline suppresses changed; process explicitly reports initial content
snapshots.retry: reuse the accepted snapshot; never silently replace it with current upstream bytes
snapshots.activation: existing exact-byte Auto/Manual approval and reconciliation; bundled scripts remain unexecuted
